bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, under the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看多，仍低于 10 日均线

read.en: AAOI jumped 15.6% on Nov 11 to $55.86, trading $51.53–57.92. It is above the 5-day ($50.66) and below the 10-day ($58.73), 30-day ($81.43), 100-day ($104.93) and 200-day ($114.89); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($45.15), and RSI is 37.5.
read.zh: AAOI 11月11日大涨 15.6%，收于 $55.86，盘中区间 $51.53–57.92。股价位于 5 日均线（$50.66）上方，10 日（$58.73）、30 日（$81.43）、100 日（$104.93）和 200 日均线（$114.89）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月11日转为看多（$45.15），RSI 为 37.5。

read.en: The rally reclaimed the $50.8–52 zone (Feb 11 high, 5-day, Nov 10 high) and the $54.03 Nov 9 high, now support; the $57.92 high stalled under the 10-day. Resistance is $56.9–58.7 (Nov 5 high, Nov 4 low, 10-day), then $62.5–64.1 (Nov 2–3 closes, Nov 4 high) and $66.3. Support is $54, then $50.7–52 and $45.2. A close above $58.7 would target $62.5–64; below $50.7, $45–46.

s.en: 5-day average $50.66; Feb 11 high $50.8; Nov 11 low $51.53; Nov 10 high $51.99
Parabolic SAR and Nov 6 low $45.15; Nov 5 low $45.88
s.zh: 抛物线 SAR 及11月6日低点 $45.15；11月5日低点 $45.88
